parsed.g: Create an issue in the a11yproject repo with title '401 bad gateway', assign it to Roshanjossey, and set the due date to the end of 2030 (December 31, 2030).
P_t: Navigated to the a11yproject.com repository page
Navigated to the Issues section of the a11yproject.com repository
Clicked 'New issue' to open the new issue creation form
Entered the title '401 bad gateway' in the title field
R_t: Assign the issue to Roshanjossey (currently showing 'Unassigned' per ground-truth DOM)
Set the due date to December 31, 2030
Click 'Create issue' to submit the form
parsed.e_t: The agent is on the 'New Issue' creation page for The A11Y Project / a11yproject.com. The title field contains '401 bad gateway'. The Assignee button shows 'Unassigned' (expanded: False), meaning no assignee is currently selected. The due date textbox is empty. The 'Create issue' button is present but has not been clicked.
C: The issue must be created in the a11yproject repo (The A11Y Project / a11yproject.com)
The title must be exactly '401 bad gateway'
The assignee must be Roshanjossey (Roshan Jossy @Roshanjossey)
The due date must be set to the end of 2030 (December 31, 2030)

F_t.action: Clicked link [8058] 'Roshan Jossy @Roshanjossey' to assign the issue
F_t.cause: The dropdown was open and the agent clicked the correct link, but subsequent steps show the assignee button reverted to 'Unassigned', indicating the selection did not persist — likely because clicking the button [7677] again at step 7 toggled/closed the dropdown and deselected the assignee

F_t.action: Clicked button [7677] at step 7 while assignee showed 'Roshan Jossy'
F_t.cause: Clicking the assignee button again when it showed 'Roshan Jossy' reopened the dropdown and deselected the assignee, reverting it to 'Unassigned'

F_t.action: Clicked link [8175] 'Roshan Jossy @Roshanjossey' to assign the issue
F_t.cause: Selection appeared to work (button showed 'Roshan Jossy') but was undone when agent clicked button [7677] again at step 9

F_t.action: Clicked button [7677] at step 9 while assignee showed 'Roshan Jossy'
F_t.cause: Clicking the assignee button again deselected the assignee, reverting to 'Unassigned'

F_t.action: Repeated pattern of selecting Roshan Jossy then immediately clicking [7677] again to deselect
F_t.cause: Agent misread the state — after selecting Roshan Jossy, the button label changed to 'Roshan Jossy' (expanded: False), but agent thought it was still 'Unassigned' and clicked it again, reopening the dropdown and deselecting

F_t.action: Same deselection pattern repeated at steps 13, 15, 17, 19, 21, 23, 25
F_t.cause: Agent consistently misidentified the assignee button state — after successfully selecting Roshan Jossy (button shows 'Roshan Jossy' expanded: False), agent incorrectly believed the assignee was still unset and clicked the button again, which toggled the dropdown open and deselected the user. Ground-truth DOM at step 25 confirms assignee is 'Unassigned'

K_t: The assignee for Roshanjossey in the dropdown is listed as 'Roshan Jossy @Roshanjossey'
The assignee button [7677] toggles the dropdown open/closed — clicking it when assignee is already selected will deselect the assignee
After selecting Roshan Jossy, the button label changes to 'Roshan Jossy' with expanded: False — this means the selection was successful and the dropdown is closed; do NOT click the button again
To confirm the assignee selection, the agent should close the dropdown by clicking elsewhere or pressing Escape, not by clicking the assignee button again
The due date textbox has ID [7133] and is labeled 'Select due date'
The title '401 bad gateway' is already correctly entered in textbox [6623]
The correct due date to enter is 2030-12-31 (December 31, 2030)
